Veterans Benefits: Rhode Island fully exempts military retirement pay from state income tax. Qualifying veterans and surviving spouses may also receive local property-tax exemptions, with amounts varying by city or town.
Description: North Kingstown is a coastal Washington County town on Narragansett Bay, home to General Dynamics Electric Boat's Quonset Point facility — a 400-acre submarine hull fabrication and module-assembly complex employing over 7,000 workers, one of the largest single defense-employer sites in this dataset. Crime runs well below the national average, and the town is regularly ranked among the safest in the country.
